mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in real GDP growth below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative GDP growth signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index below 98% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative industrial production signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the real sales and food services index above 2% signals accelerating consumer spending, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive consumer spending signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market strength that increases consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals monetary easing that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
